[RAOT.9.4] Load-time refusals. Each but the `mmap` failure will take a code of
its own in the `-550..-599` band, allocated when this loader binds; -550 to
-553 are reserved and are not those codes ([IERR.2.8b]).

| Condition | Refusal |
|---|---|
| `node_id = 0` | a code of the band |
| `node_id` not in node map | a code of the band |
| `kind` does not match node type | a code of the band |
| `mmap` fails | `DS_ERR_OOM` |
| `mprotect` fails | a code of the band |
